Equal-value stablecoin routes: executed issuance, redemption
and funding
The working thesis assigns one common value U to one whole unit of every eligible pStable:
pDAI, pUSDC, pUSDT and the admitted issuer coins. This is the system's proposed accounting and parity
rule. Observed market quotes can differ; those differences provide the proposed arbitrage opportunities.
Receipt tokens, LP shares and foreign-currency assets first require their own exchange-rate
normalization. U becomes a dollar promise only with a funded dollar-reference exit.
The October 3 search establishes additional functioning local connections. Most notably, a September 30
transaction bought discounted mUSD through Curve, redeemed part of it for all four basket stables and
converted the proceeds into native PLS. FEI has a simpler, funded one-for-one pDAI conversion. An
Inverse governance proposal actually minted a large amount of the existing DOLA coin. Across's changed
administration moved substantial local stablecoin inventory into market trades. None of these
transactions establishes fresh private-L2 collateral delivery.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 227

Why the common value matters
A protocol accepting two basket coins near one-for-one can connect markets that currently price those
coins differently. For example, buy cheap pUSDC, obtain an admitted issuer coin, redeem for a scarce
pDAI, and sell or retain that pDAI. Conversely, buy discounted issuer coins and redeem their reserves.
Each operation must satisfy the actual basket, mint, redemption and liquidity rules. Shared accounting
gives the comparison rule; the route supplies the executable quantities.
These routes can redistribute existing capital, realize market differences and finance inventory. Lending-
funded operations also create liabilities. A common valuation does not make those liabilities disappear or
replenish assets already paid out. A recurring L2 branch must show its accepted destination token and
funding input, rather than only a private-chain label.
mUSD: recent executed market-to-issuer arbitrage
At block 27,677,491, on 30 September 2026 at 12:05:35 UTC, this transaction deployed a
temporary trading contract and performed the following operations:
Operation Receipt-confirmed quantity
Pay pUSDC into the mUSD/3CRV Curve route 332.580073 pUSDC
Receive existing mUSD 3,514.021960458029333023 mUSD
Burn mUSD across four redemptions 896.975403751798273907 mUSD

pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 228

Operation Receipt-confirmed quantity
Receive sUSD 145.369503792975478359 sUSD
Receive pUSDC 143.443901 pUSDC
Receive pDAI 155.079448251736530091 pDAI
Receive pUSDT 451.543364 pUSDT
The remaining mUSD was sold through other local pools; the receipt accounts for the full acquired mUSD
quantity. Initial native funding was 26,704.810084659172875544 PLS. The contract returned 
228,173.113310542683909513 PLS to the sender. Subtracting initial funding and 
1,415.103716302431089681 PLS of transaction gas leaves 200,053.199509581079944288 PLS
of net native proceeds. T welve sampled token balances at the trading address were zero in the
preceding block. This establishes this transaction's local cash flows; it does not establish recurring
capacity, external-dollar profit or the trader's connection to the hypothesized wallet group.
The exact issuer is 0xe2f2a5c287993345a840db3b0845fbc70f5935a5; its Curve metapool is 
0x8474ddbe98f5aa3179b3b3f5942d724afcdec9f6. The receipt and historical trace show the four underlying
payments coming from mStable's existing Aave and Compound integration contracts. The September
redemptions used cached underlying; they did not call the lending pools. mStable's contract
documentation describes the upstream basket and integration interfaces; this finding comes from the
saved PulseChain transaction.
At the October 3 resource pin, the integration contracts' directly held cash is only about 2.951588
sUSD, 2.912429 pUSDC, 3.148679 pDAI and 9.167871 pUSDT. The basket records larger
investment claims, but sampled Aave reserve-data and aT oken balance getters revert. These
observations do not prove that every withdrawal is impossible. They do prevent counting the nominal
basket as currently withdrawable cash without further evidence. Current quotes still show a large
market-versus-redemption difference; quotes do not test underlying withdrawals.
The complete selected postfork mStable event search returned 72 receipt-verified events: 29
Minted, four MintedMulti and 39 Redeemed. The four September 30 redemptions are the latest in
that search.
mUSD also connects to lending-funded issuance
An October 24, 2024 transaction, sent by 0x48fc8b22ae5319786a8e25ef49b1b49942000000, used a Balancer flash-
loan callback and transferred 1,000,000 pUSDC into mStable's Compound integration. It minted 
998,634.756111707391994433 mUSD, borrowed 963,458.121028 pUSDC from Compound's
cUSDC market, redeemed portions of mUSD for underlying stables and sold the remainder through
Curve. The funding contract received its million-pUSDC principal back.
This proves a real Balancer funding → mStable collateral deposit → Compound borrowing →
issuer redemption/Curve sale connection. The continuing Compound debt is part of the financing
ledger. The stablecoin outputs alone are not net income. The same sender also executed older Across
root bundles; that address-level overlap does not establish the sender's identity or coordinated control of
both protocols.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 229

FEI: an existing fixed-parity conversion with substantial cash
The SimpleFeiDaiPSM at 0x7842186cdd11270c4af8c0a99a5e0589c7f249ce accepts the existing pDAI address and
issues existing FEI at 0x956f47f50a910163d8bf957cf5846d573e7f87ca. Its verified source transfers one pDAI in for
one FEI, or receives one FEI and pays one pDAI out. This module's conversion does not consult an oracle.
Redeemed FEI is held for a later burn rather than burned immediately.
One saved mint deposited 2,115.690961647546400768 pDAI and issued exactly that many FEI. A
May 24, 2026 redemption returned 162,213.391725678525310538 pDAI for the same quantity of
FEI. A June 15 redemption similarly paid 5,365.6583048387362816 pDAI. The full selected postfork
module search returned 103 Mint and 214 Redeem events, all receipt-verified without query gaps.
The May 24 redeemer is the user-identified 1967 wallet, 0xfdbee32bcf68bb0ced033200373384a619c71967. Three
minutes earlier, it exchanged 179,876.007186616736577400 TRIBE for exactly the subsequently
redeemed FEI quantity through the existing V2 pair 0x9928e4046d7c6513326ccea028cd3e7a91c7590a. TRIBE's
exact address is 0xc7283b66eb1eb5fb86327f08e1b5816b0720212b; current getters confirm the identity and 18
decimals. This is a demonstrated TRIBE → funded FEI market → fixed-parity pDAI redemption
route used by a named research wallet. It does not establish the wallet's original TRIBE funding or profit
after valuing that input.
At the resource pin, the PSM contains 39,092,598.332549153109816030 pDAI, remains an
authorized FEI minter, and its mint/redeem flags and FEI's pause flag are false. This is a concrete funded
local redemption branch. It has finite pDAI inventory; public mints add that inventory, while redemptions
consume it. Those pDAI tokens also back other FEI claims and cannot all be assigned exclusively to the
proposed campaign.
The existing FEI/3CRV metapool is 0x06cb22615ba53e60d67bf6c341a0fd5e718e1655. Its sampled 100-FEI quotes
return about 100.201370 pDAI, 223.956170 pUSDC or 229.315149 pUSDT. These are separate
output quantities at a fixed snapshot, not dollar prices or a proven combined arbitrage. Compare the
acquisition cost and all legs at the same trade size. The existing FEI identity already fits the pool;
ordinary issuance and trading do not require a Curve coin-list change.
The shortest L2-linked candidate here is authenticated delivery of existing pDAI → FEI PSM →
existing FEI/3CRV pool. A differently addressed bridge representation needs an accepted conversion
first. Across's checked chain-88888 token route does not currently establish that delivery.
Origin and Inverse: two distinct issuance models
A saved Origin mint transferred 900 pUSDT from the caller to the Origin vault at 
0xe75d77b1865ae93c7eaa3040b038d7aa7bc02f70 and minted 900 existing OUSD at 
0x2a8e1e676ec238d8a992307b495b45b3feaa5e86. Its historical trace includes the vault's oracle consultation. This
verifies ordinary accepted-collateral issuance. It does not show acceptance of an arbitrary new L2
receipt. Nine OUSD zero-address issuance events were receipt-verified in the broad search.
Inverse proposal 109 executed through GovernorMills 0xbeccb6bb0aa4ab551966a7e4b97cec74bb359bf6 and
timelock 0x926df14a23be491164dcf93f4c468a50ef659d5b. It minted 10 quadrillion DOLA at the existing address
0x865377367054516e17014ccded1e7d814edc9ce4 to 0x2eec75d3b370a95b7198c4daadb198c9509df785, alongside INV/DBR
actions. Its last action transferred timelock administration to 0x1b65b3ce1e463c6020e684cd8968e4cd330ab053,
which then accepted administration. Current getters confirm proposal state Executed, that administrator,
and the timelock as DOLA operator. The operator may mint even when its separate minter flag is false.
This establishes an executed governance-authorized local supply route and an administrator transfer. It
does not identify the ultimate controller of the custom administrator or link that controller to the other
named wallets. DOLA quantities become usable funding when a compatible market pays counterassets.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 230

DOLA → Balancer/Curve → pUSDC → existing pDAI
The large recipient transferred 120 million DOLA to one contract and withdrew it again, then sent 120
million DOLA to 0xba020c1a5fa7dda6ed1a02f41fbde5325d8fcf73. A subsequent transaction on October 31, 2023,
called by that same recipient, performed this complete funding chain:
Leg Actual flow
150 Balancer sales, each 80,000 DOLA 12,000,000 DOLA → 1,024,995.605256 pUSDC
DOLA/FRAXBP Curve underlying swap 100,000,000 DOLA → 16,075,670.154045 pUSDC
Maker USDC PSM collateral deposit 17,100,665.759301 pUSDC
Maker DaiJoin issuance to the trading contract 17,100,665.759301 pDAI
The 150 smaller sales executed inside one transaction; they are not evidence of a ten-second schedule.
The same transaction also used INV, including purchases of DOLA, so consolidated economics must
include that input. The table reconciles the specified DOLA-derived pUSDC proceeds and their exact
conversion into pDAI; it is not a profit statement.
Authorized DOLA mint
        ↓
Balancer DOLA/pUSDC + Curve DOLA/FRAXBP
        ↓
Existing pUSDC
        ↓  Maker PSM: accepted collateral at one-for-one accounting
Existing pDAI
The Curve pool is 0xe57180685e3348589e9521aa53af0bcd497e884d; it reaches pUSDC through the FRAX/pUSDC
base pool. The Maker PSM is 0x89b78cfa322f6c5de0abceecab66aee45393cc5a, its USDC join is 
0x0a59649758aa4d66e25f08dd01271e891fe52199, and DaiJoin is 0x9759a6ac90977b93b58547b4a71c78317f391a28. The trace
shows sellGem, the Vat collateral/debt accounting and DaiJoin's mint of the existing pDAI address. Maker
records the PSM debt against deposited pUSDC; this is distinct from the separate 86ff borrower and Aave
Portal backing. The primary PSM reference explains the upstream conversion.
This large route executed historically, but its normal Maker PSM leg is currently disabled. The
resource pin reports Vat.live = 0; verified Vat code requires live = 1 for frob, which both PSM directions
use. Zero current tin/tout fees and nominal debt-ceiling room do not bypass shutdown. Maker's
configured End reports shutdown at April 16, 2025, 06:27:15 UTC. Its USDC settlement rate is about 
0.000879277935257436 pUSDC per pDAI, a separate prorated settlement rule rather than the
proposed equal-unit rule. Actual settlement access and remaining collateral require their own
accounting. Administrative issuance is also a separate permission path; it is not established by ordinary
PSM access. None of the six sampled operator/trading addresses is a Vat ward.
The 1967 wallet also initialized that PSM-USDC-A settlement rate through this June 2026 End.flow
transaction. This function is public; calling it does not prove governance ownership. The complete
selected End history contains 90 receipt-verified shutdown/settlement events, including nine Cash
events, but none of those Cash events is for PSM-USDC-A. Current End has zero allocated internal
USDC collateral, while the USDC join holds about 113.692 million pUSDC and the PSM position
remains recorded. Physical tokens at the join are not automatically available to an End claimant. The
next concrete settlement check is whether collateral processing can move the PSM position into End,
followed by funded pack/cash and join withdrawal. This is a proposed accounting route; it was not
executed or simulated in this research.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 231

Across: substantial local inventory movement, followed by market sales
After a June 19, 2026 emergency deletion, 0xa3414934e9220ad7d81c64449842084d2641c5a2 proposed a new root
bundle at 05:51:25 UTC. Execution at 08:38:15 UTC sent the following from HubPool 
0xc186fa914353c44b2e33ebe05f21846f1048beda to local SpokePool 0x5c7bcd6e7de5423a257d81b442095a1a6ced35c5:
Token Hub-to-Spoke quantity
pDAI 1,347,161.201028105891530236
pUSDC 10,699,577.784957
pUSDT 173,268.617415
Under the thesis's common-value assumption these sum to 12,220,007.603400105891530236 U.
This is not an independently established US-dollar amount. Copied WETH and WBTC were also
transferred. Copied WETH at 0xc02a…6cc2 wraps native PLS on this fork.
The trace uses the verified Ethereum_Adapter, a same-chain pass-through. The event's inherited chain
label is 1, while actual Spoke refund leaves specify chain 369. Subsequent successful refund claims paid
the proposer 1,347,311.207536981046850455 pDAI, 10,704,238.399741 pUSDC and
177,473.841197 pUSDT, plus other assets. Refund amounts exceed the new Hub payments; existing
Spoke inventory contributes too. Count the transfer and refund as consecutive uses of the same assets,
not two funding additions.
Within minutes the recipient sold the pDAI and substantial pUSDC/pUSDT through local market routes.
Selected receipts show payment in the token 0x02dcdd04e3f455d838cd1249292c58f3b79e3c3c, whose symbol is
WETH. This is a different address from copied WETH; these trades alone do not prove its external
redemption.
The June 30 chain-88888 administrative relay also executed local calls. After a local Spoke
implementation upgrade, the July 2 chain-88888 relay delegated to custom adapter 
0x3233f8c0db384a2a1d6a307de41a804dfe411eb6. Its 15-call trace moved local Hub assets directly to 
0x83fa95ce3671d4f40d9ada7105b245ac911cbbd8, including 1,817,316.581867 pUSDC and
289,925.729137970519362629 pDAI. That wallet then sold assets through local markets. The
custom adapter has no verified source in this batch; conclusions are limited to observed calls.
These are real funding-disposition routes. They do not show a fresh L2 deposit, collateral mint or
authenticated remote delivery. At the October pin, HubPool is paused; thirteen checked chain-88888
token mappings, including the examined stablecoins, return zero. Across's upstream overview describes
liquidity-funded relayer repayment; the copied fork's actual traces determine the findings above.
Most valuable next evidence
The new priority is replenishment of a demonstrated conversion. For mUSD, find an actual post-
September cache refill or funded withdrawal from its Aave/Compound investments. That distinguishes an
ongoing common-value conversion from a short opportunity using the remaining cache. For the L2
thesis, seek a fresh authenticated delivery of an admitted local token, then reconcile its FEI, mUSD or
sUSD conversion and resulting pStable inventory. FEI provides a particularly simple destination
conversion to test because its parity rule and liquid pDAI inventory are explicit.
The DOLA proceeds now identify a large executed route and its current Maker shutdown boundary. Trace
current DOLA market capacity and the custom Inverse timelock administrator next; inspect Maker's
settlement claims separately from its disabled PSM. For the 1967 wallet, trace the origin of the TRIBE
that financed its demonstrated FEI redemption. These investigations can establish further supply-control
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 232

and funding connections without assuming that every protocol belongs to one group. A resource-backed
rebase could replenish owned reserves, but its net realization and pool accounting still require the
checks in the funding and rebases study (Appendix 36).
Evidence and reproduction
Current resource reads use chain 369, block 27,698,092, hash 
0x95395f560a8ca8c49e9032534e7ac3285b183786ec8d731c5eadf81e0a876a52, timestamp 2 October 2026, 22:48:55
UTC (3 October in Melbourne). Historical transactions retain their own headers. The prior-inventory
check uses block 27,677,490. Do not combine different snapshots into a contemporaneous consolidated
balance sheet.
Raw RPC records, receipts, headers, historical traces and verified source downloads are retained under 
artifacts/pulsechain-equal-value-routes-20261003/. Explicit manifests are in Research/experiments/
pulsechain_*_20261003.json. Queries used getters, code/storage reads, logs, receipts and historical traces
only. No transactions, setter simulations or state overrides were submitted.
The broad ten-token mint search initially had 21 query errors and four verification gaps. The DOLA
and MIM missing ranges were repaired with 50,000-block requests; each returned zero events without
gaps. FRAX and canonical LUSD remain incomplete in that broad search. Failed queries never establish
absence. The complete mStable, FEI-module and selected Across searches independently establish their
stated scopes.
Reproduce the offline reconciliation using:
python Research/scripts/analyze_pulsechain_equal_value_routes.py \
  --input artifacts/pulsechain-equal-value-routes-20261003 \
  --output /tmp/pulsechain-equal-value-verified.json
The verifier passed 2,111 offline checks of receipt/header/trace consistency, event inclusion, exact
issued and redeemed amounts, native proceeds, retained debt, permissions, snapshots, the DOLA-to-
Maker route, the 1967 wallet's funding and local Across asset flows. The current result is verified-routes-
final.json; the SHA-256 inventory preserves the evidence used. These are consistency checks of RPC
evidence, not a cryptographic light-client proof or a complete ownership audit.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 233
